about_p1: Never been here before but owner got me in quickly!! Mechanic seemed to know his stuff and he was very cost efficient. I called around and other shots were going to charge me almost $1,000 more than he did!! He helped me find a reasonable transmission for my car and it was way less than what I was going to pay on my own. If you need your car looked at try Avant Auto repair.
about_p2: Had my car towed to his shop due to a broken A/C compressor. Was able to get it fixed and driven home within a day. Car runs perfect and better than before. Would absolutely recommend their services as it was fast, quality, and affordable work. Our car broke down on the way to a family beach vacation. We made it to an auto parts store who confirmed that the alternator needed to be replaced.

reviews.author: Monique Rogers
reviews.text: Never been here before but owner got me in quickly!! Mechanic seemed to know his stuff and he was very cost efficient. I called around and other shots were going to charge me almost $1,000 more than he did!! He helped me find a reasonable transmission for my car and it was way less than what I was going to pay on my own. If you need your car looked at try Avant Auto repair.

reviews.author: Tyler
reviews.text: Had my car towed to his shop due to a broken A/C compressor. Was able to get it fixed and driven home within a day. Car runs perfect and better than before. Would absolutely recommend their services as it was fast, quality, and affordable work.

reviews.author: Kristi Page
reviews.text: Our car broke down on the way to a family beach vacation. We made it to an auto parts store who confirmed that the alternator needed to be replaced. Unfamiliar with the area, we asked the staff there if they had any recommendations on who could replace it since it was a Friday night. Of course they all recommended Avant Auto Repair. I called to confirm and indeed Sly could do it! His shop was only about 3 miles away but the car didn't make it. Called again and he sent a tow truck and another staff to pick up the family. The place is easy to miss (behind a residential house), so I'm glad we were escorted. Customer Service was amazing. Everyone was so nice and accommodating to our family of 5. The price was SOOOOO reasonable! Definitely less than I was expecting. I'm so grateful to Avant Auto Repair. They saved our vacation!

reviews.author: Ashly Linder
reviews.text: I wish to thank you from the bottom of my heart for providing me with extraordinary customer service in such a brief period. Your unwavering dedication and expertise made our vacation a success, even in the face of adversity. I wholeheartedly recommend Avant Auto repair for all your mechanical needs. He is truly committed to his customers, offers competitive prices, and possesses a deep sense of urgency. Highly recommend , He truly help my son on Senior Week without any hesitation.

reviews.author: Justina Jones
reviews.text: Better than any other shop I’ve been too! Sly is amazing and so is his workers. He’s an honest man and I would recommend his shop to anyone. My tires were put on right and so was my sensor. They kept me laughing. Very personable. I’ve never felt so relieved getting worked done. He will look out for you. I was a first time customer but I will definitely be back if need be. Highly satisfied.

reviews.author: Asha T.
reviews.text: Sly is amazing! He went above and beyond to care for my car, including discussing additional repairs that needed to be done and throwing in extra care items for no charge. He communicated well, and proved to be honest and skilled! I'll be using his services again.

reviews.author: Alyssa Udall
reviews.text: Sly and his team are incredibly knowledgeable, proficient, and honest! You won't be price gouged here like other places nearby. I was put in a tough situation and needed a big repair done right and done quickly, and Sly stepped up and made sure it got done! Amazing people! I would never take any vehicle any where else if I could help it. Thank you Sly! You made a stressful situation so much more bearable!

reviews.author: Connie Gardner
reviews.text: Sly is THE MAN! I was very impressed with him. He repaired my car very fast and at a very reasonable rate. He's as Good as they come. I'll certainly be back and highly recommend this remarkable young Gentleman! Connie

reviews.author: Patrick P
reviews.text: Sly does an excellent and thorough job at fixing vehicles. Best price around. You won't be able to find a more affordable option so just go here. He can even tow your car for a fee if it won't move/start/drive

reviews.author: Allison Wilson
reviews.text: I had a blown fuse which caused my interior light system to go off. I called on Saturday morning after Hurricane Ian and Avant was so quick to diagnose the problem, fix it with a smile, and send me on my way. He wouldn't even let me pay him! I'm so grateful for their service, especially because so many other places were closed on Saturday. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Amber Phillips
reviews.text: Sly was great, fit me in the very next day, did my stuff real fast. And he did a good job. Also did my Lyft inspection and it was accepted!

reviews.author: Ivy Felts
reviews.text: Called in the evening, told him what I needed done. Was told "call back in the morning and we'll talk pricing" so I call back in the morning and let him know what time I can come by. He was the cheapest, I will say that. But when I got to the repair place all the lights were off, the phone was off and going straight to voicemail. I was shocked. Why tell someone you stay open until a certain time and to call when you're there but then be closed and turn your phone off? That's rude and bad business. I saw so many good reviews and had high hopes that I had found my new mechanic since I just moved down here but was let down. I wouldn't recommend him to anyone unless you can get there right after you get them on the phone.

reviews.author: Melissa Isaacson
reviews.text: My friend referred me to Avant Auto Repair 11 years ago, and it has been a blessing ever since! Sly is the most honest and fair mechanic around. I do not live close to Avant so I have been to other mechanics out of convenience over the years, and regretted it every time. Honesty and quality service above all. I highly recommend Avant Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Chris Headtrip
reviews.text: Brought my car to avant for brake replacement, he came out n towed my car right before xmas, n I swear I couldn't have paid for more than parts because he knew we were struggling financially n because of a small unavoidable delay. Oh n my brakes worked beautifully! He's a great solid mechanic to have around n I'll def recommend him n call him in the future.

reviews.author: Kenny Cherry
reviews.text: Ive been going here off and on for years and i can say that he is a good guy good prices quality work. If you have a prob after he saw it he will repair it. The only problem is that sometimes it takes longer then expected to get car back. But that's bc advance auto or somebody else gives him the wrong part frequently. Also he could never keep good consistent help there so with a ever growing clientele and little to no extra hands it gets overwhelming and he still squeezes more people in love the guy

reviews.author: Becky Russell
reviews.text: We were traveling and did not know who to call, took the recommendation of O'Reilly auto parts worker, and so happy we did. Came to us, got us back on the road, and stayed with us until he was sure we were good. Too bad we live 600+ miles away because I would definitely take all my business here. Thank you!

reviews.author: Shanti Gettys
reviews.text: He is awesome. My family has been using him for years. He is thorough and does a great job. Please call to make appointment because he is a very busy man, but his work is impeccable.

reviews.author: Angela Suggs
reviews.text: Sly is amazing!!! He replaced my sway bar links, & now I will be getting all my repairs done by him. I highly recommend him for all your Auto repair needs

reviews.author: Rhonda Robinson
reviews.text: Doesn’t deserve one star. Sly is horrible he had my car to put on a alternator and keep my car for a week and keep telling me he would have it the next day but took a week to get it. Once I got my car back he told me to call if I have any problems. So I got down the road and realized my radio, doors won’t lock, inside light won’t work. So I tried to call him back but he won’t answer so I went back to the shop and he was in the garage with his music on and won’t come out. I knocked on the door and tried to him again and he still won’t answer. I will never take my car back to him and I will not recommend him to anyone.

reviews.author: David Sims
reviews.text: Sly is one of the best mechanics around Conway. These other negative reviews being posted? These people obviously lying about Sly working on their vehicles OR they simply didn't reach out to have him check the problem and fix it if there was a problem but instead just posted negative words. EVERYONE makes mistakes, however, with Sly he's went above and beyond several times for me and other customers that I've referred to him. Hands down, Sly is one of the 2 mechanics in Conway is trust working on my vehicles. 5/5 all around.

reviews.author: Jay Shelton
reviews.text: Treats you like family and takes great care of your vehicle! This company came highly recommended. I and my family have been loyal patrons since 2017.

reviews.author: donna waugh
reviews.text: Amazing customer service! My car broke down Saturday late afternoon and he had it done by 3pm on Sunday. Very happy with the service I received.

reviews.author: Michael Maxfield
reviews.text: Avant auto repair really helped me out when he came and replaced an alternator, I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Dennis Hansen
reviews.text: This is the ONLY person who puts their hands under the hood of my vehicles....always takes care of the problems and always charged reasonable rates! To me...the best is Conway!

reviews.author: Nancy Champion
reviews.text: I have come to Avant Auto on several occasions and never had any issues so far... fair and reasonable
